"}, {"insert": "你知道Deepfake有多可怕吗？"}, {"insert": "

"}, {"insert": "

"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2022年，他和人合伙创立了Facia。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "核心产品有三："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Pay with Face", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": " ——刷脸支付，不用密码"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "DeepFake Fraud Prevention", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": " ——检测伪造媒体"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Face Recognition Ticketing", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": " ——刷脸进场，告别纸质票"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "二、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "灵感从哪来？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "同事的妈妈叫网约车。接单的人，和来接她的人，不是同一个。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "在南亚，这可能很危险。一个陌生人，冒充别人，上了你的车。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Daniyal决定解决这个问题。强制平台验证用户身份，把骗子踢出系统。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他的AI和机器学习背景，正好派上用场。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "验证想法时，他们做了大量研究。找行业专家聊，给部分企业试用早期原型。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "反馈非常积极。他们发现，这技术的应用远不止Deepfake检测。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "三、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "产品开发花了多久？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "大约6个月。边上班边做，精益创业，只做核心功能。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "资金来自内部资源，用开源工具降低成本。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "技术栈主要是Python，后端和机器学习都用它。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "最大的技术挑战？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "既要快，又要准。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "实时检测，还不能误报。这要求他们不断优化模型和基础设施。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "四、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "另一个难题是平衡安全和体验。"}, {"insert": "

"}, {"insert": "他们试了又试。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "还有各种边缘情况——光线不好、摄像头质量差、用户行为各异。导致无数轮迭代和测试。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "商业模式很简单：B2B SaaS，按用量收费。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "根据API调用次数定价，有适合初创公司的套餐，也有企业定制方案。还提供白标解决方案。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们从MVP验证完就开始收费。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "第一批付费客户来自金融科技和政府机构，想防身份欺诈。"}, {"insert": "

"}, {"insert": "收入稳步增长，现金流健康。"}, {"insert": "

"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "然后靠口碑和案例研究，打开更多门。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "

"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在他们有200+ B2B客户，月访客1.5万，处理了数百万次API调用。"}, {"insert": "

"}, {"insert": "解决一个真实的问题，解决得极好，然后持续听用户的。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "写在最后"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Daniyal的故事告诉我——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "最好的创业时机，往往跟技术趋势同步。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Deepfake泛滥，身份欺诈增多，市场紧迫感创造了明确需求。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "

"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你真的能解决问题。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Daniyal的AI技术背景，让他能快速迭代产品。这才是核心竞争力。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "所以他的建议是："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "找个细分领域。别试图解决所有问题，先解决一个具体的小问题。但确保它是真实的、痛的、人们愿意花钱解决的。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "还有，别等"完美"产品。早点上线，拿反馈，快速迭代。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "

content_en: He made face recognition tool specifically for fighting Deepfake earning seven figures. Inspiration came from colleague mother personal experience. Do you know how scary Deepfake can be. One photo of you can generate realistic video. Some use it for fraud some use it to create fake things. Daniyal Chughtai could not stand it. He made Facia AI tool specifically for detecting Deepfake and identity fraud. Now serving over ten million end users annual revenue two hundred fifty to three hundred fifty million dollars. One. Daniyal studied economics and math. He knows one principle where there is demand there is market. AI demand is exploding so he pursued masters in big data science. Then entered fintech industry got obsessed with anti fraud. Twenty twenty two he co-founded Facia. Core products three. Pay with Face face payment no password needed. DeepFake Fraud Prevention detecting forged media. Face Recognition Ticketing face entry say goodbye to paper tickets. Two. Where did inspiration come. Colleague mother ordered ride share. Driver who accepted order and driver who came to pick her up were not the same. In South Asia this could be dangerous. A stranger impersonated someone got on your car. Daniyal decided to solve this.
